hook: Your gas stove lighter makes sparks without batteries.
title: Your Stove Lighter Needs No Battery
description:
Click-style gas lighters use a piezoelectric crystal. A spring-loaded hammer squeezes the crystal, and that squeeze makes a high-voltage spark. Try it next time you light the stove.

#Shorts #Science #HowItWorks
comment_prompt: Heard of piezo before? Yes or no
